thread:
Lina (Marketing): Quick ask for the webinar pack — can runtime run a very compact smoke that we can quote on the webinar slides? Need numbers + one heatmap. Not full bench, just a reproducible mini-run.

Vik (Runtime): Yep. Which models and which demo payloads? small curated demo or the full marketing bench?

Lina (Marketing): Use the curated demo set in our shared drive (~40 sessions, varied token lengths). Models: redwood-alpha-v2 and redwood-alpha-v2-q8. Outputs we need: p50/p95/p99 latencies, average token/s, batch size distribution, and a coldstart heatmap covering minute 0-10. Also a short note on any quality deltas.

Tao (PerfEng): I can capture GPU util, host CPU, and batch timeout distributions. Also happy to export a tiny plot of token/sec vs batch-size.

Lina (Marketing): Thanks. Deadline: COB Monday. We only need 2 runs per variant: cold (no prior cache) and warmed (5 synthetic warmups + 20 demo warmups). Keep runs short.

Vik (Runtime): Understood. Will run 2 x 2 (variants x cold/warm). We'll produce: metrics.csv, batch_hist.png, coldstart-heatmap.png, samples.txt, run-manifest.txt. Will attach a 1-line caveat per artifact if we observe anything notable.

Lina (Marketing): Please also include a per-demo token-cost estimate (rounded). We map that to the pricing blurb.

Ravi (Product): Also include whether the q8 binary required fallback to mixed precision on any node. We need that noted for risk slide.

ops-bot: Run scheduled: job r-20260415-55c3, queue started.

Vik (Runtime): Run plan posted:

```
redwood-run --model redwood-alpha-v2 --payload marketing_demo_40.json --runs 2 --warmup "5syn+20real" --collect-util --out /tmp/webinar-smoke/alpha-v2
redwood-run --model redwood-alpha-v2-q8 --payload marketing_demo_40.json --runs 2 --warmup "5syn+20real" --quantize q8 --out /tmp/webinar-smoke/alpha-v2-q8
```

Tao (PerfEng): Note: if cold p99 for q8 > 3s on long prompts we'll try a single re-pass with batch_timeout=30ms and record the delta.

Lina (Marketing): Good call. Please call out any re-runs and why. Also copy artifacts to s3://marketing-assets/webinar-q2/compact-smoke/ when done and ping this thread.

Vik (Runtime): Will do. Small eval note: we'll run a quick automatic lexical parity check on 6 sample outputs. If divergence >1.5% we'll flag for follow-up.

Lina (Marketing): Perfect. If anything blocks Monday deadline call it out here so we can escalate.

Vik (Runtime): No blockers foreseen. Posting artifacts link when uploaded. Thanks :raised_hands:

[thread archived after artifact upload]
